name: Dune
failureMode: No destruction. Above overwhelmSeverity, absorption is cut to overwhelmedAbsorptionMultiplier for that hazard, but the dune survives to the next one.

name: Sandy Vegetation (Pandanus)
failureMode: No destruction. Weaker physical protection than a Dune, but the cheapest defense on the roster and the best biodiversity return per Coin.

name: Seawall
failureMode: Breaches above failureThreshold: destroyed, redirects unabsorbed surge onward at failureRedirectMultiplier.

name: Mangrove
failureMode: No destruction. Above overwhelmSeverity, absorption is cut to overwhelmedAbsorptionMultiplier for that hazard, but the buffer survives to the next one.
note: PLACEHOLDER money magnitude (STEP_PROMPT_economy_food_yacht.md item 1) — deliberately the smallest of the four money-generating elements (Sand Mining 14 > Beachside Resort 5 > Khazan 2 > Mangrove 1): Mangrove's value proposition is Biodiversity/Food, income is a bonus, not its purpose. Feed into STEP_PROMPT_balance_tuning.md's harness once re-run against this roster.

name: Khazan (Bundh & Sluice)
failureMode: No catastrophic breach. Above capacity, or after sustained maintenance neglect, effectiveness degrades gradually rather than the structure being destroyed.
note: PLACEHOLDER money magnitude (STEP_PROMPT_economy_food_yacht.md item 1) — nudged 1->2, modest but clearly ahead of Mangrove's 1 without approaching Beachside Resort's 5, reflecting Khazan's already-well-rounded hybrid profile (Biodiversity +2, Food +1). Feed into STEP_PROMPT_balance_tuning.md's harness once re-run against this roster.

name: Small Dam
failureMode: Breaches above failureThreshold: destroyed, redirects unabsorbed surge onward at failureRedirectMultiplier.
note: PLACEHOLDER money/resilience magnitudes (STEP_PROMPT_visuals_map_river.md item 3 / PROGRESS.md). resilience is POSITIVE as of this pass — earlier revisions had it negative; re-framed as a flood-control structure, not a flood-defense-trading one. absorptionAtMaturity/failureThreshold (unchanged, already strong) are what hazard.ts actually reads today — effects.resilience is forward-compatible data for the not-yet-built zone-based resolution model (GAUNTLET_PROMPT.md v3.0 Section 2/11).

name: Sand Mining
failureMode: No catastrophic breach — it simply offers almost no flood protection (absorptionAtMaturity 0.1, far below Small Dam's 0.75). An untouched river tile is the flood's own source and is skipped entirely (zero damage); building anything on it — Sand Mining included — makes it start taking damage instead, and Sand Mining's near-absent absorption means that damage is close to the full undefended amount.
note: PLACEHOLDER NUMBERS (STEP_PROMPT_visuals_map_river.md item 3): only the direction of each effect is specified (money up, biodiversity down, resilience down). Tuned here — cheaper to build than Small Dam, no maintenance cost, meaningfully higher Money return — so it isn't simply worse than Small Dam in every respect, per that file's explicit balance flag; not a settled/tested number.

name: Yacht
